body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sharp introduced four new HD 1080p AQUOS models featuring high-speed response time and enhanced contrast ratio of 1500:1.

The D92 series includes the 52-inch LC-52D92U, 46-inch LC-46D92U, 42-inch LC-42D92U and 65-inch LC-65D93U. It supports the most advanced version of Sharp''s true 16:9 1080p Advanced Super View Panel, produced at LCD plant in Kameyama, Japan.
This four new launch models will be available until this March for MSRP of $3,500, $4200, $5300, and $11,000 respectively.
